topics.title: Classification Basics
topics.description: Feature spaces, supervised learning setup, decision regions, and baseline ideas.

topics.title: Bayesian Classification

topics.title: Density Estimation

topics.title: Nearest Neighbour Classifiers

topics.title: Classifier Evaluation
topics.description: Training/test estimates, overfitting, precision, recall, ROC space, cost matrices, and operating points.

topics.title: Decision Trees
topics.description: ID3, entropy, information gain, symbolic vs numeric splits, pruning, and tree depth.

topics.title: Common Classifiers

topics.title: Improving Learning Results
topics.description: Feature selection and construction, model selection, parameter optimization, ensembles, and post-processing.

topics.title: Neural Networks

topics.title: Deep Learning
topics.description: Tensor mappings, convolutional layers, data augmentation, depth, representation, and SED architectures.

topics.title: Unsupervised Learning
topics.description: k-means, mean quantisation error, Gaussian mixture models, BIC, and clustering model selection.
